script.title: The Pelican Pedal Express
script.description: An enormous white pelican leans into the handlebars of a cherry-red bicycle, its golden bill and deep orange throat pouch leading the way. Swept feathers, offset webbed feet, open spoked wheels and a brass bell give the sculpture a lively riding gesture.
